settings.notes: fee_percent_* = everything Shopee takes as a % of the price after the shop's own voucher (commission + programme service fee + transaction fee; never MY Ads Escrow Top-Up, which is ad money counted in ad spend; for GST-registered SG shops, Shopee's % ÷ 1.09 + 8.26). fixed_fee_per_order = flat Shopee amounts per order (MY platform support RM0.54; SG seller-paid shipping by parcel weight). packing: 'self', 'warehouse' or 'fbs'. other_cost_per_order = warehouse or Fulfilled by Shopee fees per order, tax included. overhead_per_order = monthly_fixed_costs ÷ orders_per_month (staff, rent, tools, warehouse minimums). voucher_percent / affiliate_percent = the monthly P&L's seller vouchers ÷ product price and AMS ÷ net sales (for the realistic break-even). fees_from: 'real orders' or 'fee table'.

notes: products: {"product", "price", "cost", "preorder", "left_before_ads", "margin_percent", "break_even_roas", "break_even_ad_cost", "realistic_break_even_roas"}. cost = what one unit costs you to buy or make, including getting it to you or your warehouse. preorder (MY only) adds Shopee's 2.16% pre-order fee. The last four are worked out by Claude.
